description: Get the git diff of current changes. Can diff staged, unstaged, or against a specific base branch/commit. Returns file paths and hunks.
name: read_diff

base.description: Base ref to diff against (e.g. 'main', 'HEAD~3'). Default: unstaged changes.

path_filter.description: Limit diff to a specific path or glob.

staged.description: Show staged changes only (--cached). Default: false.
